title: The derived pairing, and perfectness of a pairing
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, integers $a,n\geq1$, and the global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]: $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and its algebraic closure $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside it, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$, with the finite, derived-complete integral, rationalized and common-finite-stage coefficient categories, respectively, of [sk-def-sf-setting]. As in the fixed setting [sk-def-set], let $X_0/k_0$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and geometrically connected [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] of pure dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-pure-dimension], put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ (base change [def-pc-base-change]), $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $a_X:X\to s$ be its structure morphism. Properness of $X_0$ and an ambient exceptional-adjoint admissibility datum are not assumed.

Use the bounded constructible finite-Tor category $D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ on the small pro-étale site and the six operations of [sk-def-ops], with the constructible exceptional adjunction $Ra_{X!}\dashv Ra_X^!$. Write $\Lambda_X$ for the coefficient unit, $\RGammac(X,-)=\operatorname{Fib}_s Ra_{X!}$ and $\RGamma(X,-)=\operatorname{Fib}_s Ra_{X*}$. Tate twists are $M(d)=M\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)$ as in [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]; at the integral stage the coefficient unit and tensor product are completed, and at the two field stages they are the prescribed scalar extensions. Use the mixed-support cup product $\smile_c$ and normalized smooth trace $\Trsm_{a_X,\Lambda}$ of [sk-def-pairing-data], the latter being the exceptional counit read through the canonical smooth orientation $\Lambda_X(d)[2d]\cong Ra_X^!\Lambda$.

Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ be perfect over $\Lambda_X$ in the dualizable sense of [sk-def-perfect]. Put $K^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_X(K,\Lambda_X)$. The evaluation $\operatorname{ev}_K:K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}K^\vee\to\Lambda_X$ is the tensor–internal-Hom transpose of $\operatorname{id}_{K^\vee}$; its twist $\operatorname{ev}_K(d)$ is the composite
$$
K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}(K^\vee\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d))
\cong (K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}K^\vee)\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)
\xrightarrow{\operatorname{ev}_K\otimes1}\Lambda_X\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}\Lambda_X(d)
\cong\Lambda_X(d).
$$
The *derived Poincaré pairing* is the composite

$$
\begin{aligned}
\beta_K:\ \RGammac(X,K)\otimes^L_\Lambda\RGamma\bigl(X,K^\vee(d)\bigr)[2d]
&\xrightarrow{\ \smile_c\ }
\RGammac\bigl(X,K\otimes^L K^\vee(d)\bigr)[2d]\\
&\xrightarrow{\ \RGammac(\ev_K(d))[2d]\ }
\RGammac\bigl(X,\Lambda_X(d)\bigr)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\ \Trsm_{a_X,\Lambda}\ }\Lambda,
\end{aligned}
$$

that is, $\beta_K=\Trsm_{a_X,\Lambda}\circ\RGammac(\ev_K(d))[2d]\circ\smile_c$.
The evaluation arrow lands in $\RGammac(X,\Lambda_X(d))[2d]$, whose
cohomology need not be concentrated in degree $0$ (for $X=\mathbf P^1_k$,
$d=1$, $K=\Lambda_X$ it lives in degrees $-2$ and $0$); the
normalized smooth trace of [sk-def-pairing-data] is the specified map to $\Lambda$, inducing the normalized trace on $H_c^{2d}(X,\Lambda_X(d))$; no decomposition of that complex is part of the definition.

For perfect point complexes $C,D$ in the sense of [sk-def-perfect], put $C^\vee=R\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(C,\Lambda)$. A morphism $b:C\otimes^L_\Lambda D\to\Lambda$ 
is *perfect* if its tensor–internal-Hom adjoint $D\to C^\vee$ is an
isomorphism.

split_report.summary: Split the definition through five existing constituent definitions; no new nodes or Mathlib leaves. Expanded the inherited finite-field, scheme and four-stage coefficient setting to repair B2, and wrote the evaluation and its twisted associator/evaluation/unitor composite explicitly. Preserved the three-arrow pairing and perfectness-by-adjoint criterion. Clarified the illustrative cohomology warning as “need not”, rather than the literally false universal “is not”, and avoided assuming a canonical splitting when describing the trace. The etale Lean constructions cover only part of the pro-etale four-stage item, so no exact attachment. Authentic Mathlib queries are copied from searches.jsonl, with rejected queries and invalid initial grep scopes explicitly marked.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the entire current main-20261015 sk-def-pairing definition: mixed-support cup product followed by shifted twisted evaluation and normalized smooth trace, and the final perfect-pairing predicate. The unit has no proof steps. Expanded the inherited data through its existing pairing-data -> ops -> fixed-setting/coefficient chain and made the twisted evaluation composite explicit; no new proof route or theorem is introduced.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NR-b588814fe (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Checked the item against the current main-20261015 blueprint section sk-def-pairing (order 2762) and the current sk-def-pairing-data, sk-def-ops, sk-def-set and sk-def-perfect sections. The written-out setting matches sk-def-set: no properness and no admissibility; pure dimension d is equivalent to smooth of relative dimension d. The category is pro-etale D^b_ctf with the constructible exceptional adjunction, as in sk-def-ops. The twists, including the completed integral unit, follow def-coefficient-twists-detailed. The evaluation is the transpose of id_{K^vee}, and ev_K(d) is associator, then ev tensor 1, then left unitor; this agrees with slopmaster2 twistedEvaluation. The three-arrow composite is the source's; the [2d] shift moves through tensor and R Gamma_c by the canonical isomorphisms. Perfectness takes the adjoint D -> C^vee, in the right direction. The disputed wording is justified: 'is not concentrated' is false for X_0=Spec F_q, d=0, so 'need not be' is correct, and P^1 gives degrees -2 and 0. 'Selects the top-degree summand' became 'induces the normalized trace on H_c^{2d}'; these agree because the complex sits in degrees <=0, and nothing is weakened. All five dependencies say what the item takes from them. The unit has no proof steps, so citations are empty, there are no tool_uses, and there is no cycle (DFS). def-sf-pairing is correctly in same_as. The slopmaster2 Pairing.lean has [Finite Lambda] and an etale, non-normalized orientation, so no attachment is correct. Edge cases checked: K=0, C=D=0, the zero pairing on Lambda (not perfect), d=0. One B3 fault, repaired: the written-out setting used smooth, separated, finite type, geometrically connected, pure dimension, base change and the finite-field datum without citations. The fix file adds def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible, def-weil-pure-dimension, def-pc-base-change, def-weil-finite-field-fiber and sk-def-set to the statement and to stmt_deps, with no mathematical change; it is at fixes/dag/nodes/sec-poincare-duality/sk-def-pairing.json.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
